about: PBR texture sets for Ashen Abyss. Each set: albedo.jpg (sRGB), normal.jpg (OpenGL), arm.jpg (R=AO,G=roughness,B=metallic, linear), height.jpg (linear displacement, mid-grey ~ surface), optional emission.jpg / opacity.jpg. size_m = real-world metres covered by one UV repeat (uv_scale = world_metres / size_m).
